title: the frozen progress event contract of the api freeze
description: freezes the progress event names and the progress record shape: the plan progress carries its completed steps, its outcomes, its task tabs and its per step environment, turnaround, gate wait, perf and delta records while the step outcome carries its ok flag, summary, details and environment; the event names of the record families join the frozen contract.

eventnames.description: the frozen progress event name families of the progress record

runid.description: the run record the progress links to

completedsteps.description: the executed step ids in order

outcomes.description: the step outcomes of the completed steps

tasktabs.description: the tabs assigned to the running task

environments.description: the execution environment of every completed step by step id

turnarounds.description: the worker turnaround of every offloaded step by step id

gatewaits.description: the gate wait evidence of every gated step by step id

perf.description: the perf record of every executed step by step id

deltas.description: the snapshot change set of every executed step by step id

prior.description: the prior progress snapshots preserved across plan replacements

updatedat.description: the epoch milliseconds of the last update

ok.description: the success flag of the outcome

summary.description: the plain language summary of the outcome

details.description: the structured payload of the outcome

environment.description: the execution environment the step ran in

at.description: the epoch milliseconds of the outcome
